name: Vedrixa Forms – Registration & Contact Form Builder
author: registrationformbuilder

sections.description:
Vedrixa Forms is a WordPress form builder plugin designed for site owners who need a flexible way to create contact forms and registration forms without writing code.

You can design forms in wp-admin, configure form behavior, publish forms anywhere using shortcode, and review submissions from a dedicated admin screen.

Whether you are running a business website, membership portal, or community site, Vedrixa Forms helps you manage lead capture and user signups from one interface.

Core Features

  • Drag-and-drop form builder for fast form creation
  • Contact form and registration form support
  • Multiple field types including text, email, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, date, and file upload
  • Conditional field logic to show or hide fields based on user input
  • Frontend form rendering with shortcode
  • Form validation to improve data quality
  • Email templates and notification settings
  • Auto-responder options for user communication
  • Form limits and post-submission actions
  • Global settings for security and account-related behavior
  • Submission manager in wp-admin with filters and pagination

Common Use Cases

  • Create a contact form for inquiry, support, or callback requests
  • Build a custom user registration form for your WordPress site
  • Collect leads for marketing campaigns
  • Receive structured form submissions from landing pages
  • Manage submissions in one place from your WordPress dashboard

Why Vedrixa Forms

  • Friendly visual form builder workflow
  • Suitable for non-technical WordPress users
  • Clean shortcode integration with posts and pages
  • Practical feature set for both contact and registration workflows

Shortcode:

[wpefb_registration id="FORM_ID"]

External Services

This plugin can connect to Google reCAPTCHA when you enable reCAPTCHA in the plugin settings. reCAPTCHA is used to help protect your forms from spam and automated abuse.

When reCAPTCHA is enabled, the plugin loads Google reCAPTCHA scripts on the frontend form page and sends the visitor’s IP address, browser information, interaction data, and the reCAPTCHA token to Google to validate the submission. It also sends the generated token to Google’s verification endpoint when the form is submitted.

This service is provided by Google:

  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vedrixa-forms-registration-builder folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Vedrixa Forms” in wp-admin.
  4. Create a form and copy its shortcode.
  5. Paste the shortcode into a page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support both contact and registration forms?

Yes. You can choose form type while creating a new form.

Can I display the form on any page?

Yes. Copy the shortcode generated for your form and paste it into any post, page, or widget area that supports shortcodes.

Can I manage submitted entries from WordPress admin?

Yes. Vedrixa Forms includes a submissions manager where you can review entries and use built-in filtering and pagination.

Does Vedrixa Forms support conditional fields?

Yes. You can use conditional field logic to show or hide fields dynamically based on selected values and user input.

Does this plugin include spam protection options?

Yes. You can configure Google reCAPTCHA from plugin settings to reduce spam submissions.

How do I show a form on frontend?

Use the generated shortcode in any page/post, for example:
[wpefb_registration id=”1″].
